caption: The drawing depicts an antique sewing machine with ornate details. The base of the machine is black with gold decorative patterns and floral motifs, and the corners feature feet shaped like animal paws in a bronze or copper color. The main body of the sewing machine is cylindrical and vertically ribbed, resembling a fluted column, and is colored in black with gold accents. There is a large, round hand crank wheel with a wooden handle attached to the right side. The sewing mechanism is located on the left, with components in shades of black, gray, and metallic silver, and a small orange-brown surface where fabric would be placed. The entire drawing has a beige or light tan, plain background, and the artist's signature, "Harold Oldfield," is visible in the lower right corner.
title: Sewing Machine
